baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active verbs عَلِمَتْ, قَدَّمَتْ, and أَخَّرَتْ make one self both the knower and the agent across a before/later opposition.
baseline_models.mechanism: Disclosure joins inner intention to asymmetric action: the self recognizes what it deliberately moved into precedence and what it assigned to postponement rather than merely recalling two neutral time bins.

activation_trace.role: The clearing of a thing to its knower supplies the moment in which the self's own temporal choices become apprehensible.
Inner mind and hidden intent make the knowing self answerable for the purpose inside both initiative and delay.
Forward advance and precedence render تقديم as an active placement of something ahead.
Deferral to a later time renders تأخير as an assigned delay, not simply an event that happened late.

changed_reading.before: The self remembers a chronological list of earlier and later deeds.
changed_reading.after: The self apprehends its own allocation of action: what it intentionally put ahead and what it intentionally left for later.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired roots ق د م and ء خ ر carry physical forepart/rear images, while عَلِمَتْ and نَفْسٌ can activate mark and very-self images.
baseline_models.mechanism: The temporal merism acquires a spatial layer. The acting self leaves an arranged trace from leading edge to rear, and that complete trace functions as the distinguishing surface by which the very self recognizes itself.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points to its object turns knowledge into recognition through the self's own trace.
The very thing itself makes the self, rather than an external abstraction, the bearer of the trace.
The forepart and leading edge provide the front pole of a whole spatial ordering.
The rear or posterior part supplies the matching back pole, making the pair exhaustive rather than merely sequential.

changed_reading.before: Advanced and delayed divide deeds only by time.
changed_reading.after: They also map a complete self-trace: what was installed at the leading edge and what was relegated to the rear.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative pair قَدَّمَتْ / أَخَّرَتْ contrasts chosen forward movement with chosen postponement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The pair diagnoses a disposition, not only an inventory. Courageous or intended undertaking and the room left unused by deferral expose how resolve was directed, including culpable withholding and omission.

activation_trace.role: Resolve and character locate the advance/retreat contrast in the self's operative disposition.
Bold forward undertaking supplies initiative as one side of the contrast.
Intentional turning toward a thing makes the forward act purposive rather than accidental.
Postponement supplies withholding as the active counterpart to undertaking.

changed_reading.after: The verse also exposes the self's pattern of initiative and withholding: what it dared or intended to undertake and what it kept postponing.

context_deltas.mechanism: A descending series of enclosures loses integrity: a cover splits, ordered lights scatter, stored waters burst out, and buried contents are overturned. The focus then reads as the corresponding opening of an inward archive, where both what went ahead and what was put behind become forcibly legible.

activation_trace.role: Cognitive disclosure is the focus-level result of the surrounding losses of concealment.
The inner mind and hidden intent form the innermost enclosure reached by the sequence.
Prior deeds are deposits already sent before the self and waiting in the opened archive.
The rear image gives concrete placement to what had been pushed out of immediate view.
Opening by splitting initiates the loss-of-containment mechanism.
Casting contents in dispersion shows an ordered field becoming an exposed distribution.
Wide rupture and outflow turn stored depth into released content.
Burial supplies the final and most literal hidden repository before the focus.
Turning soil and exposing what was buried completes the archive-opening analogy.

structural_cues: 82:1-4 repeat إِذَا with passive ruptures before 82:5 abruptly gives the self an active verb of knowing.
The sequence descends from the highest cover through visible order and water-depth to burial, then lands on the inward self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies splitting, scattering, bursting, burial, and overturning; I infer that their ordered loss of containment also models an archive being opened and makes the self's knowledge compulsory. A live alternative is that they establish only the time and scale of judgment, without an archival analogy.

changed_reading.before: The self calmly remembers its past when the cosmic signs occur.
changed_reading.after: The self is itself the last enclosure to open, and its advanced and deferred deposits become unavoidable evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interrogation about deceptive generosity recasts delay as a moral act. Ongoing repair, nurture, growth, and honor provide genuine room, but deceptive glitter converts that room into a false inference of immunity; what the self 'delayed' includes its misuse of granted respite.

activation_trace.role: Leeway and delay make the self's available room a morally charged resource.
Forward undertaking marks the response that granted room enabled but did not compel.
Deferral gives the focus its direct hinge from available time to abused postponement.
Deception by something that glitters but does not hold supplies the false appearance of safety.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the real beneficent process that the deceived self misreads.
The split mapping's growth and feeding image sharpens respite as sustained development rather than neglect.
Honor and praised generosity explain why the respite is real even though the inference of immunity is false.

structural_cues: 82:6 immediately turns 82:5's report into a second-person question about what produced the human's misreading.
The question places deception and generosity in one construction, requiring their relation rather than treating generosity as the deception itself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deceptive glitter together with nurture, growth, and generosity; I infer the arrow 'continued gift becomes presumed exemption,' so delay itself enters the account. Alternatively, the deception may arise from a different unnamed source and generosity may only intensify blame.

changed_reading.before: What was delayed is simply work not completed before a deadline.
changed_reading.after: Delay is itself disclosed as a choice to convert nurtured and generously extended room into imagined immunity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measurement, straight completion, balance, form, and composition make the focus's forepart/rear branches newly functional. The self was composed in an ordered form, then its choices continually promote some tendencies to the leading edge and relegate others to the rear, producing a moral configuration it comes to know.

activation_trace.role: The very self is the configured whole on which the front/rear ordering operates.
The forepart and leading edge supply the position into which choices promote traits or acts.
The rear supplies the position to which choices demote or conceal other traits or obligations.
Estimating and measuring provide the first operation in an ordered composition.
Straightness and completion supply an integrated initial configuration.
Setting a thing upright and balanced provides a relation among the composed parts.
Form and figured appearance make the ordered whole perceptible as a configuration.
Putting one thing into another supplies the assembly mechanism that links bodily composition to self-ordering.

structural_cues: 82:7 chains three formative verbs directly on the addressed human, and 82:8 culminates in form and تركيب.
The focus's front/rear pair precedes this explicit account of an ordered and composite human form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a measured, balanced, composed human form; I infer that repeated choices analogically recompose the self by moving elements toward its front or rear. The live alternative is that 82:7-8 concern only the Creator's physical formation and do not license moral self-composition.

changed_reading.before: The self knows separate acts positioned earlier or later.
changed_reading.after: The self knows the configuration those choices made of it: what it promoted to its leading edge and what it pushed to the rear.

context_deltas.mechanism: Denial of accounting is answered by guarded inscription and observers who know enacted work. The focus's inward disclosure therefore converges with an independently preserved act-record: neither private self-description nor external notation alone exhausts the account, especially where hidden intention produced delay or omission.

activation_trace.role: The self's disclosure supplies the inward witness that will meet the external record.
Inner thought and hidden intent preserve the dimension that bare outward notation might not explain.
Intentional aim links the outward act to the inward purpose known by the self.
Contradiction of truth establishes the epistemic conflict that the two witnesses overcome.
Accounting and recompense specify why preserved knowledge of action has adjudicative force.
Guarding a thing supplies continuity and resistance to loss in the external record.
Fixity of what is preserved in mind mirrors the focus's internal knowing across the external guardians.
An inscription that establishes judgment turns observation into an operative account.
The observers' clear knowledge echoes the focus verb and creates epistemic convergence.
The production of an act defines the outward material known and written by the observers.

structural_cues: 82:9's denial is followed by عَلَيْكُمْ, guardians, writers, and a plural knowing verb aimed at what you do.
The repetition of the same علم root in 82:5 and 82:12 places self-knowledge and observer-knowledge on opposing sides of the denial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, guarded writing, observers' knowledge, and enacted work; I infer that the self's disclosure and the preserved record converge as mutually checking witnesses. A live alternative is that the two knowledges remain parallel rather than functioning as a reconciliation of intent and act.

changed_reading.before: The self's knowledge is a private memory sufficient on its own.
changed_reading.after: The self's inward knowledge is forced into agreement with a guarded external record, exposing both enacted work and the intentions behind postponement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired groups are not merely awarded abstract totals; they are located inside opposed conditions, one agreeable and one burning, and absence from the latter is negated. Prior deeds thus read as precursors that prepare an inhabited outcome toward which the self arrives, while deferred consequences wait there for it.

activation_trace.role: The very self is the eventual inhabitant, not merely the owner of an abstract score.
A precedent deed that has gone ahead supplies the causal material already waiting at the destination.
Arrival from a journey turns precedence into a trajectory that later reunites deed and doer.
Deferral explains how a consequence can be produced now yet encountered at a later terminus.
Truth carried through word and work supplies the constructive trajectory of one group.
An agreeable place and pleasant dwelling make the good outcome explicitly inhabitable.
Deviation and violation of a boundary supply the destructive trajectory of the opposed group.
Intensely kindled heat gives that trajectory a materially experienced environment.
Meeting fire and its heat supplies direct contact between the self and its outcome.
The split target independently preserves the same fire-contact image and reinforces encounter rather than remote observation.
The day's event and severity provide the terminal occasion on which deferred effects are inhabited.
Accounting and recompense connect the inhabited condition causally to what went ahead.
Concealment from sight, explicitly negated in the ayah, blocks any final separation from the produced condition.

structural_cues: 82:13-14 use matched إِنَّ ... لَفِي constructions to place opposed groups inside opposed states.
82:15 adds temporal encounter and 82:16 negates absence, converting classification into unavoidable inhabitation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truthful work or violation, opposed environments, fire-contact, accounting, and negated absence; I infer a causal arrow in which deeds help compose the condition the doer later inhabits. Alternatively, the states may be externally assigned recompense without being described as produced environments.

changed_reading.before: Advanced and delayed deeds are entries later rewarded or punished from outside.
changed_reading.after: What the self sends ahead helps prepare an outcome it must inhabit, while the encounter with that consequence can be delayed but not escaped.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled challenge about knowing the day echoes the focus's عَلِمَتْ, but the final ayah removes every self's power of disposal for another self and locates authority elsewhere. Focus-knowledge is therefore a verdict-like disclosure arriving exactly when knowledge can no longer be converted into revision, exchange, rescue, or control.

activation_trace.role: Clear apprehension supplies the knowledge that remains after practical control collapses.
The very self localizes disclosure in the same unit whose power is later negated.
The split mapping's direct knowledge branch makes the first rhetorical challenge an explicit echo of the focus.
Repetition of direct knowledge intensifies the gap between apprehending the day and mastering it.
Accounting and recompense make the disclosed knowledge judicially consequential.
The severe event of the day supplies the setting in which knowledge and helplessness coincide.
Ownership and power of disposal are the precise capacity negated between selves.
The very-self image repeated twice isolates each accountable self from transferable self-help.
The knowable, reportable thing is negated without qualification, making the loss of disposal exhaustive.
Authority and its holder identify the control from which individual selves are excluded.
The worshipped deity is the stated terminus of authority after self-to-self disposal is denied.

structural_cues: 82:17 and 82:18 repeat the same question about knowing, then 82:19 answers structurally with a total negation of self-to-self power.
The focus has one self know its own acts; the ending repeats نفس twice but severs every transfer between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated epistemic challenge, accounting, negated disposal, and relocated authority; I infer that the focus's self-knowledge arrives as recognition without remedial agency. A live alternative is that the repetition only magnifies the day's unknowable scale and does not comment on the utility of 82:5's knowledge.

changed_reading.before: Knowing one's record may still imply an opportunity to explain, trade, repair, or obtain rescue.
changed_reading.after: The self knows exactly when knowledge has ceased to be leverage: it can recognize its advanced and deferred acts but cannot revise or transfer their account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant و س م inventory behind the context's س م و and lets the mark branch of ع ل م shadow an ordinary verb of knowing. It remains anchored because the focus inventory explicitly supplies a distinguishing mark and the later writing sequence supplies durable notation. Downstream prose should say the self becomes legible 'as if marked by its trace,' never translate عَلِمَتْ as 'was marked.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عَلِمَتْ is retained as knowing, while its root's distinguishing-mark branch adds a secondary mode by which the self recognizes what قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that points to its object lets self-knowledge operate through readable traces.
The very self becomes the surface identified by those traces.
The split target's visible brand that makes something known activates a marked-surface analogy at the opening sky.
Ordered letters and the written object stabilize the mark analogy as a resolvable record rather than random damage.

changed_reading.before: The self receives information about deeds as a purely inward cognition.
changed_reading.after: The self also recognizes itself as a readable, marked surface whose distinctions point back to what it put ahead and behind.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because نَفْسٌ plainly denotes a self and the split ر ب و cue occurs under رَبِّكَ, yet the packet explicitly joins breath, leeway, and rising breath-images to a finite duration. The reading remains anchored in نَفْسٌ and أَخَّرَتْ as an embodied analogy for postponement. Downstream prose should qualify it as a respiratory clock or 'borrowed breathing room,' not as the lexical meaning of the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the breath-capable self beside active deferral, and its own ن ف س inventory includes both outgoing breath and granted leeway.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body provides the embodied unit by which remaining opportunity can be imagined.
Leeway, distance, and delay turn breath into a bounded budget of room.
Deferral spends that room by assigning response to a later time.
The split mapping's rising and swelling breath image activates a respiratory clock within the question about the sustaining Lord.
A bounded duration supplies the endpoint at which breathing room no longer extends postponement.

changed_reading.before: Delay is an abstract placement on a calendar.
changed_reading.after: Delay can be felt as expenditure of finite breathing room: each extension sustains the self while reducing the room in which it can still act.

strongest_changes: The four rupture ayat turn self-knowledge into the final opening of an archive rather than calm recollection.
The question about deceptive generosity makes postponement itself accountable as misuse of real nurture and respite.
Guarded writing and observer-knowledge force inward intent and outward action into one non-deniable account.
The closing sequence separates perfect recognition from all power to revise, transfer, or control what is recognized.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained temporal, intentional, spatial, and compositional readings at once: advance/delay could be chronology, initiative/withholding, forepart/rear, deposited evidence, and a trajectory into inhabited effects. Split mappings added contained mark and breath activations without displacing the plain syntax.
remaining_uncertainties: The front/rear and moral-composition model may be a productive structural analogy rather than a semantic pressure in the focus verbs themselves.
It remains open whether what is delayed includes omitted acts, delayed consequences, deliberately hidden material, or different combinations of these.
The record sequence clearly preserves enacted work, but its relation to inward intention is inferred through the focus self rather than stated as part of the writing.
The marked-self and breath-budget readings depend on form-distant split-root branches and should remain explicitly exploratory.
